 
Sessional Order 2026 – Completion of the 3rd Session of the 43rd Legislature Page 1 
Sessional Order 2026 – Completion of the 3rd Session of the 43rd Legislature 
 
MOVED BY: 
 
SECONDED BY: 
 
THAT the following Sessional Order applies for the duration of  the Forty-Third Legislature, despite any other 
Rule or practice of this House. 
 
1. On Thursday, October 15, 2026: 
a) During Routine Proceedings the Government will move First Reading of The Budget Implementation 
and Tax Statutes Amendment Act 2026 (2)  
b) During Orders of the Day – Government Business, the House shall only consider Concurrence and Third 
Reading of the following Bills: 
(No. 13) – The Residential Tenancies Amendment Act 
(No. 21) – The Drinking Water Safety Amendment Act 
(No. 54) – The Smoking and Vapour Products Control Amendment Act 
(No. 56) – The Liquor, Gaming and Cannabis Control Amendment Act 
(No. 58) – The Limitations Amendment Act (Intimate Partner Violence) 
 
2. On Thursday, October 15, 2026: 
a) If Routine Proceedings have not concluded 90 minutes prior to the usual adjournment hour, the Speaker 
must terminate Routine Proceedings and proceed to Orders of the Day. 
b) The Minister, Critics and each Independent Member may speak for a maximum of 10 minutes on each 
Government Bill moved for Concurrence and Third Reading.  
c) Matters of Privilege and Points of Order will be deferred until all votes are completed. 
d) The House will not adjourn until the questions have been put on each of the Bills listed in item 1 b). 
 
3. On Monday, October 26, 2026, during Orders of the Day – Government Business, the House shall resolve 
into the Committee of Supply to consider departmental estimates. 
 
4. On Tuesday, October 27, 2026: 
a) During the first hour of Orders of the Day – Private Members Business, the House shall consider 
Concurrence and Third Reading of Bill 232 – The Autism Strategy Act, if the Bill has been reported to 
the House. 
b) During Orders of the Day – Government Business, under the provisions of Rule 31 the House shall 
consider an Opposition Day Motion, if the Motion is filed with the Clerk on Monday, October 26, 2026. 
 
5. On Wednesday, October 28, 2026: 
a) During Orders of the Day – Government Business, the House shall resolve into the Committee of Supply 
to consider departmental estimates. 
b) If the consideration of departmental estimates has not been concluded by 5:00 p.m.: 
i. The Chairperson(s) shall put the question on all remaining resolutions without debate.  
ii. Matters of Privilege and Points of Order will be deferred until all votes are completed. 
iii. The Committee and the House will not adjourn until the questions have been put on all resolutions. 
 
6. On Thursday, October 29 , 2026, the House will not adjourn until the questions have been put and Royal 
Assent granted for the following items: 
a) The Business of Supply set out in sub-rule 76(1) including The Appropriation Act; and 
b) The Budget Implementation and Tax Statutes Amendment Act 2026 (2)  
c) The Bills referenced in items 1 and 4 of this Sessional Order. 
 
=====PAGE
 
Sessional Order 2026 – Completion of the 3rd Session of the 43rd Legislature Page 2 
Any remaining steps for items a) and b) not dealt with 60 minutes prior to the usual adjournment hour will 
have all remaining questions put following the applicable provisions outlined in sub-rules 2(23), 2(25) and 
2(26). 
 
7. The House shall not sit during the week of November 2, 2026, unless it is required under sub rule 2(4). 
 
8. The 4th Session of the 43rd Legislature shall commence on November 17, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. 
 
9. After adoption by the House, this Sessional Order may be amended only by: 
a) unanimous consent of the House; or 
b) passage of a subsequent Sessional Order by the House; or 
c) written agreement of all House Leaders if the House is not sitting.
